profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack engineer who specializes in backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and payments. I like the challenge of jumping into large, messy codebases and shipping features that scale under heavy volume.
Right now, I’m at Costco Travel building high-volume booking systems and anti-fraud (3DS) integrations. Before this, I spent nearly four years as a technical consultant dropping into engineering teams at Meta, Microsoft, and Expedia to design cloud APIs and scale infrastructure.

My core stack includes Java, C#/.NET Core, Python, and Azure/AWS. Because I like pushing tech forward, my side projects right now focus on building distributed pipelines for Generative AI music production and real-time spatial computing with Meta Quest.

When I’m not at my keyboard, I captain the Lynnwood Recreation Masters swim team and train early on weekdays. Feel free to connect if you want to talk architecture, fintech, or distributed systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Booking Portfolio (Production Support)
- Created cobranded Visa promotions which gave our Costco customers over $2m+ cashback in shop cards.
- Domain specific Visa requirements for compliance depending on the domain and ports stopped by cruise sailing.
- Developed and supported 3-Domain Secure (3DS) domain specific authentication to mitigate online fraud risks.
- Added American Express card type to payment processors.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Java · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Consulting Software Engineer with Meta, Microsoft, Technicolor and Fiserve
- Developed and delivered new application with new API high-impact features within 6 months having 100k plus daily API calls.
- Lead development of new customer authentication and authorization mechanisms using cloud infrastructure while working with multiple external teams.
- Designed and implemented a scalable architecture that allowed our platform to handle more concurrent users for geographical region for Azure.
- Wrote Scripts to deploy azure instances and connect to azure CI/CD pipelines for deploying v2 of Microsoft Translator which uses more robost API and new features for end users. Improved load performance and browser memory usage from v1

positions.title: Software Engineer E1
positions.description:
Full Stack Web Developer - Collaboration with Microsoft Minecraft Division(three different projects) using Wordpress(Bootstrap, PHP, CSS, SQL, Ajax, JSON, Javascript, Angular,React, JQuery, HTML5, C#, Angular, and cosmosDB). Add functionality to websites that have over 6 million registered users and maintaining production level websites while enhancing user's experience.

Functions: 
1. Built websites using the Azure stack and integrated new pages to existing domains. 
2. Rewriting functionality to cache JSON data on the client to minimize calls to server and implemented client side dynamic loading.
3. Finding security holes that passed through QA and securing website with up to date standards in web applications.
4. Integrated sale functionality to items related to projects and wrote unit tests. 
5. Implemented geographical routing to different databases in case of down time.
6. Enhanced client's experience and boost customer relations with fast implementations. 
7. Created middeware for API bridge for API's to communicate with each other.
8. Created Azure functions to automate sanity checking and validate end user's submission.


Tools: Visual Studio(TFS Work items and Code), Heidi SQL(MySQL client Interface), Sublime Text(PHP editor), Drupal(Worlds website), Azure, Ubuntu(Linux), NGINX Web Server, Azure Redis Cache.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
An iOS application created with a team used by the Bellingham Civil Air Patrol (Air Force Auxiliary). Worked on this project with four other developers and has since been released to the customer.

Functions:
1. Wrote software requirements specifications(SRS) and software user documentation(SDD).
2. Communicated with client routinely to ensure customer satisfaction.
3. Wrote scripts to grab 110,000+ png images to replace existing Apple map overlay.
4. Integrated project export to be viewed in Google Earth.

positions.title: Software Tutoring
positions.description: Helping other students within the community to better understand the art of programming and to succeed in school.

positions.title: Lifeguard and Swim Instructor
positions.description: Job required supervising the safety and rescue of swimmers. Over the course of my time here, I have saved over 30+ individuals and taught 100+ kids/adults how to swim.
